description: CorpMind sample evaluation set for the fictional Northwind Analytics corpus in sample_docs/. key_facts: every group must appear in the answer (any one alternative per group). relevant: documents (and pages, where it matters) that contain the answer.

items.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees get?
items.expected_answer: Full-time employees get 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accruing at 2 days per month.

items.question: How many unused leave days can I carry forward, and when do they expire?
items.expected_answer: Up to 10 unused annual leave days can be carried forward; they expire on 31 March of the following year.

items.question: When do I need a medical certificate for sick leave?
items.expected_answer: A medical certificate is required for sick leave longer than 3 consecutive days.

items.question: How long is maternity leave?
items.expected_answer: 26 weeks of paid maternity leave, of which up to 8 weeks may be taken before the expected delivery date.

items.question: What is the paternity leave entitlement and by when must it be taken?
items.expected_answer: 10 working days of paid paternity leave, taken within 3 months of the child's birth or adoption.

items.question: How far in advance must I apply for planned leave of a week, and where?
items.expected_answer: Planned leave longer than 3 days must be applied for in PeopleHub at least 7 days in advance and approved by the reporting manager.

items.question: How many days a week can I work from home?
items.expected_answer: Up to 2 days per week, agreed in advance with the manager, after completing the 90-day probation.

items.question: What are the core hours when remote employees must be available?
items.expected_answer: 11:00 to 16:00 IST, responding on chat within 30 minutes.

items.question: Is there a home office allowance for remote work?
items.expected_answer: Yes, a one-time home office allowance of INR 15,000 for eligible employees.

items.question: Can I work from abroad for a few weeks?
items.expected_answer: Only with written approval from HR and the CISO, and for at most 30 days per calendar year.

items.question: What is the minimum password length?
items.expected_answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters; MFA is mandatory.

items.question: I lost my laptop. How quickly must I report it and how?
items.expected_answer: Report to the Security team within 1 hour using form SEC-01 or the #it-security channel.

items.question: Can I paste confidential client data into a public AI chatbot?
items.expected_answer: No. Only the approved Northwind AI Gateway may be used, and Confidential or Restricted data must never be pasted into public AI tools.

items.question: What is the hotel limit per night in a metro city?
items.expected_answer: INR 7,000 per night in metro cities (INR 4,500 in non-metro cities).

items.question: Within how many days must I submit an expense claim, and which form do I use?
items.expected_answer: Within 30 days using form FIN-12 in ExpensePro; claims after 60 days need CFO approval.

items.question: Who is allowed to fly business class?
items.expected_answer: Employees at Grade L5 and above, on flights of 6 hours or longer.

items.question: What is the car mileage reimbursement rate?
items.expected_answer: INR 12 per km for car mileage (INR 6 per km for two-wheelers).

items.question: On what date is the Diwali holiday in 2026?
items.expected_answer: 8 November 2026.

items.question: What is the limit on accepting gifts from business partners?
items.expected_answer: Up to INR 5,000 per year per partner; gifts above that must be declined or reported to Compliance.

items.question: Which mandatory trainings must new joiners complete, and by when?
items.expected_answer: Information Security, POSH and Code of Conduct trainings within 30 days of joining.

items.question: When is salary paid each month?
items.expected_answer: On the last working day of each month.

items.question: How much internet reimbursement can remote employees claim per month?
items.expected_answer: Up to INR 1,500 per month, claimed through ExpensePro.

items.question: Compare the Leave Policy and the Remote Work Policy on what applies to employees on probation.
items.expected_answer: Leave Policy: probationers accrue leave but can avail at most 6 days of annual leave. Remote Work Policy: remote work only after completing the 90-day probation.

items.question: Summarize the Information Security Policy
items.expected_answer: Covers 14-character passwords with mandatory MFA, 5-minute screen lock, blocked USB storage, four data classes, incident reporting within 1 hour via SEC-01, and annual security training.

items.question: What is the company's pet insurance policy?
items.expected_answer: FALLBACK

items.question: What is the dress code for the annual gala?
items.expected_answer: FALLBACK

items.question: Who won the 2023 Cricket World Cup?
items.expected_answer: FALLBACK

items.question: What is the salary range for grade L4?
items.expected_answer: FALLBACK

items.question: What is Project Falcon and what is its budget?
items.expected_answer: FALLBACK

items.question: What is the salary range for grade L4?
items.expected_answer: Grade L4 (Lead): INR 22 to 32 lakh per annum, bonus target 12%.

items.question: Are vendor payments pre-approved, or what approval do they need?
items.expected_answer: Vendor payments require a purchase order approved by the department head; nothing is pre-approved.
